A '''llim''' was an ancient type of [[Lantern/Legends|lantern]] carried by patrols on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] species.<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> By a [[Time/Legends|time]] when the lantern's usage by Ithorian patrols was the distant past, some Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|males]] had "Llim" as a given name that translated to "night patrol warden."<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The llim was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
